channel.title: Crypto Bulletin
channel.description: Crypto Bulletin reports crypto news on bitcoin, ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation, security incidents and market structure.

item.title: How zerofi’s wrapped assets fit into DeFi
item.description: ZeroFi’s wrapped assets make deposits usable in DeFi on another chain, but their value depends on backing, redemption and the bridge that connects them.

item.title: New York seeks $1.37bn from NovaTech founders
item.description: New York is asking a court to order Cynthia and Eddy Petion to pay $1.37 billion over NovaTech, after a default judgment found them liable in 2025.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT and targeting 150-millisecond finality, a change that could speed settlement and free block space.

item.title: Solana activates Alpenglow, targeting 150ms transaction finality
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing its old consensus system with a 150-millisecond finality target while keeping wallets, apps and fees unchanged.

item.title: How Much Crypto Reaches the Other Chain?
item.description: The amount that arrives depends on network fees, swap pricing and destination costs; compare the quoted output with the amount sent before approving a cross-chain transfer.

item.title: How to avoid a failed transfer to Manta Pacific
item.description: Most failed Manta Pacific transfers come from the wrong source chain, missing native gas, or an unfinished claim step — check these before you bridge.

item.title: How to Reconcile Recurring Cross-Chain Treasury Transfers
item.description: Match each transfer’s source and destination records, fees and status to one treasury entry so recurring movements stay auditable across chains.

item.title: Byreal perpetuals: set a stop loss before opening a trade
item.description: Byreal lets traders attach take-profit and stop-loss levels to perpetual orders; choose the market, set direction and size, then check the trigger and margin.

item.title: Standard Chartered signs deal for 100% of Zodia Custody
item.description: Standard Chartered will buy 100% of Zodia Custody’s parent, subject to approvals, folding custody into Securities Services while software moves to a separate SC Ventures company.

item.title: Portal Bridge transfers depend on the route, token and redemption
item.description: Portal Bridge moves tokens through a source-chain transaction, a signed cross-chain message and destination redemption; the route determines fees, timing and token type.

item.title: Kazakhstan court bars Coinbase and five others in AIFC
item.description: Kazakhstan’s AIFC Court barred six crypto platforms from unlicensed services, with app-store access restrictions limited to the financial centre under its order.

item.title: Omnichain costs depend on the route and app
item.description: Omnichain fees are not one flat charge: route, destination gas and the work an app performs determine transfer costs and whether users pay once or twice.

item.title: When pool fees outweigh impermanent loss
item.description: Pool fees cover impermanent loss only when your earned fees exceed your position’s shortfall versus holding the same tokens, after costs and rewards.

item.title: Mesh and Visa plan crypto spending at 175 million merchants
item.description: Mesh says its Visa partnership will let participating wallets spend crypto and stablecoin balances at 175 million merchants, with conversion handled at checkout.

item.title: Mayan bridge: how to move and swap crypto across chains
item.description: Mayan combines a bridge transfer and token swap in one transaction. Check the route, output estimate, fees and destination address before approving it.

item.title: JPMorgan makes JPM Coin available to institutions on Ethereum
item.description: JPMorgan has made its dollar deposit token available to institutional clients on Ethereum, adding a public network alongside Base for onchain transfers and settlement.

item.title: Crypto.com and Novig sue Missouri over sports event contracts
item.description: Crypto.com and Novig sued Missouri over sports event contracts, arguing federal law preempts state gambling rules as cease-and-desist deadlines expired.

item.title: Coinbase and Marqeta team up on stablecoin-backed cards
item.description: Coinbase will custody and convert stablecoin balances for cards issued through Marqeta, with settlement on Base and 24/7 program funding for business customers.

item.title: Tether freezes $10 million tied to CryptoBilis wallet theft
item.description: Tether blacklisted 37 addresses and froze $10 million across 20 wallets tied to the CryptoBilis wallet drain, as investigators continued tracing stolen funds.

item.title: Coinbase and Marqeta plan stablecoin-backed cards for businesses
item.description: Coinbase will handle custody, fiat conversion and settlement on Base for cards Marqeta customers can issue, letting users spend stablecoin balances at global merchants.
